description: Find elements on the current page by visible text and/or role WITHOUT returning the whole snapshot: matching outline lines with their [ref=…] (usable by click/type at once), a little context and the enclosing dialog/section. Far cheaper than snapshot on big pages. text is case-insensitive; wrap in /…/ for a regex.

context.description: Lines of context around each match.

role.description: Role filter, e.g. button, link, textbox, checkbox, dialog, heading.

text.description: Text to look for (name, label, value or static text), or /regex/.

name: find
